        json_schema_extra={'x-python-type': 'Callable[[int], int]'},
        title='Handler',
    )

    callback: Callable[[int], int] = Field(
        ...,
        json_schema_extra={'x-python-type': 'Callable[[int], int]'},
        title='Callback',
    )


class Probe(BaseModel):

class Task(BaseModel):

class Holder(BaseModel):
